oliver: heads-up — spotted a reproducible case where a streaming request that triggers a toolcall + client-side truncation results in double token debit. repro on staging.

maya: ugh. can you paste a minimal trace? link to trace pls.

oliver: https://staging.traces/redwood/trace/abc123 — quick paste of the relevant lines: ```STREAM_START id=abc123 model=gpt-psi seq=0
TOOLCALL start id=tc-77 token_so_far=0
TOOLCALL timeout id=tc-77 -> retry
STREAM_CHUNK seq=1 tokens=48 prefix="Hello"
STREAM_TRUNCATED reason=client_disconnect
LEDGER provisional_charge=48 confirmed_charge=0
RECONNECT resume_id=abc123-1 STREAM_CHUNK seq=1 tokens=48
LEDGER provisional_charge=48 confirmed_charge=48
```

jess: are we seeing 48+48 on customer invoice? or is one provisional and later reversed?

oliver: customers observed two confirmed debits. looks like the provisional never got auto-reversed when we reconciled because the resume path emitted a separate confirmed charge instead of reusing the provisional entry.

sam: probably a routing edge — the resume request hit a different router instance that didn't see the provisional tombstone. we have eventual consistency on the prefix ownership map.

srikanth: yeah, ownership map TTL + shard handoff race could cause that. current ledger flow: provisional rows written to /provisional -> later confirmed writes increment committed ledger. If confirm comes with a different session id we don't dedupe.

maya: simple mitigation: dedupe by (customer_id, trace_root_id, token_range_start). but risk: legitimate retries with different seq numbers might collide.

jess: console UX problem too — ops can't see provisional vs confirmed easily. Right now the console only shows final confirmed billing per session. need a quick panel showing provisional outstanding per customer so CS can triage refunds.

oliver: agreed. propose two changes: 1) attribution heuristic: on confirm, try to match to any outstanding provisional within window T (configurable, default 30s) matching same prefix hash. 2) telemetry: emit metric rbac.provisional_confirm_mismatch with tags customer/model/route.

sam: +1. for (1) we should prefer matching the earliest provisional with matching prefix, then mark it tombstoned. if multiple matches, attach to first and emit anomaly log.

srikanth: implementation caveat: some toolcalls can legitimately re-run and produce new tokens — we must not lose real usage. so conservative approach: only dedupe if the confirmed token_count <= provisional_token_count * 1.1 (allow small variance).

jess: that makes sense. also add a console flag in canary to show "provisional-aware billing" so sales/support can opt into seeing adjusted credits in the UI (not actual invoice) while we test.

maya: telemetry question: do logs currently include prefix hash and tentative token counts? iirc we only log chunk sizes but not prefix fingerprints. we should add a short prefix_fingerprint (8b) to each chunk event to make matching cheap.

oliver: yes add prefix_fingerprint. example patch: ```diff -- api/streaming.proto +++ streaming.proto @@ -120,6 +120,8 @@ message StreamChunk {   int64 seq = 1;   int32 tokens = 2;+  fixed64 prefix_fingerprint = 3;+  optional string toolcall_id = 4; }```

sam: great. rollout plan: feature-flag the dedupe heuristic behind a server-side flag, enable on 5% of traffic in canary region, surface metric delta in a new "billing-reconciliation" dashboard.

jess: dashboard panels to include: provisional outstanding over time, provisional->confirmed match rate, avg delta (confirmed - provisional), and count of unmatched confirms. Also export anomaly traces for manual review.

oliver: can we also add an alert: if unmatched confirms spike > 5/min for > 10m, page eng-platform on-call? This is revenue-impacting.

srikanth: agreed. we'll gate with rate-limited paging and a runbook: rollback flag -> assess drift -> refund flow if needed.

maya: small UX ask: Console should mark per-session rows with a yellow "provisional" badge and a tooltip: "Tokens tentatively charged; will reconcile when session completes." clicking opens the trace link.

jess: ok design + PM approved — I'll create the console ticket.

deploy-bot: canary rollout: provisional-dedupe-feature -> 5% traffic -> eng-us-west at 2024-06-18T17:03:22Z :rocket:

oliver: thx. next steps: srikanth + sam to prototype dedupe in router/ledger, maya to add prefix_fingerprint to streaming events, jess to add console panel + flag toggle. i'll own the telemetry metric and alert.

sam: will prototype matching logic this week. quick pseudocode: ```def match_confirm(confirm): candidates = provisional_store.lookup(confirm.prefix, window=30s) for c in candidates: if confirm.tokens <= c.tokens*1.1: confirm.attach(c) return true emit('unmatched_confirm', confirm) return false```

srikanth: watch out for concurrent confirms trying to attach to the same provisional — need a compare-and-swap or a DB-level lease. prefer DB transaction on provisional row marking tombstone.

oliver: good point. I'll add that to the PR checklist. any objections?

jess: none from me. go ahead. :+1:

maya: thanks — will coordinate infra changes with you all.

console-bot: ticket created: CONS-1138 "Provisional billing panel + canary flag" — assignees: jess, maya, support/CS.

oliver: closing loop here — we'll sync in next daily stand-up. if you see urgent customer hits, ping me directly.
